snippet.title: Farsight | World Premiere The Horror Game Awards 2026
snippet.description:
You know the house from the eye exam? The one in the middle of a grassy field. Farsight is a first-person dreamcore psychological horror game about a twelve-year-old kid taken for a routine eye exam who finds himself in the liminal images of the eye exam machine. Peer through keyholes, watch from a distance with binoculars, and use the FUNTIME-GO camera to see beneath the surface of a place you've somehow always been familiar with. 
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080520/Farsight/ 
Website: https://farsightgame.com/"---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards

Discord: https://discord.gg/j8wUUzJQ8D
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HorrorGameAward
Instagram: https://instagram.com/thehorrorgameawards
